additional_info.body:
Hello Yunus,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
DBE Energy
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P3 170000429
Charger ID/Serial No.:
wzcbA7
Problem Description:
DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100
JFYI-
The errors generated are as follows:
KON: 1: In case the contact temperature sensors are not okay.
PLE 1: Plausibility Error (difference of two sensors of same type too high)
VIV: 0: In case of an invalid sensor reading.
Kindly follow the steps below to troubleshoot the fault leading to these error flags:
Step 1: Turn off the power supply to the charger.
Step 2: Identify the cables P1, P2, N1, and N2 associated with Pt1000. Refer to the picture below for your reference.
Step 3: Check the ambient temperature and note it. Then, using a multimeter, measure the resistance of P1, P2, N1, and N2.
Step 4: Click on the following link to see the resistance table of Pt 1000 pertaining to the temperature and its corresponding resistance: Pt1000 Resistance Table
https://www.sterlingsensors.co.uk/pt1000-resistance-table
Kindly refer to the below knowledge article to check the cable sensor:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101 and EVSE_TempLowerLimit_ low temperature - Dynamics 365
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 10/14/2024, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Mohini Patil
